title: Coefficient four at exponent one for the certificate-prefix BK family, with the gate-elimination theorem and the affine-disperser development supplied in full

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total language L of proof.md Part A. F_N is identically zero for N<2^20. For N>=2^20 let k be the least prime with k^5>32*N^3, m=N-k, r=ceil(m/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)). Read the first k bits of x as the coefficients of the monic degree-k polynomial Q(X)=X^k+sum_{0<=j<k} x_j*X^j over F_2 (x_0 the constant coefficient). If Q(1)=0 or X^(2^k) is not congruent to X modulo Q, output 0. Otherwise set K=F_2[Z]/(Q), split the remaining m bits identically into r consecutive blocks of k bits, zero-pad the last block, read block i as the field element z_i in the basis 1,Z,...,Z^(k-1) (first bit the constant coefficient), put y_i=z_i^(2^(r+2-i)-1), and output Tr(e_t(y_1,...,y_r)), where e_t is the degree-t elementary symmetric polynomial and Tr is the field trace K->F_2.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one fixed total uniform polynomial-time family F_N, which lies in P and hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(F_N) >= 4N - 20*N^(3/5) - 160*N^(4/5) holds at every integer length N>=2^20 in the full Li-Yang B2 model, so that liminf over all integers N of C_B2(F_N)/N is at least 4 and for every epsilon>0 the explicit threshold N_epsilon=max(2^20, ceil((180/epsilon)^5)) makes C_B2(F_N)>=(4-epsilon)*N hold for every integer N>=N_epsilon.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
